scenarios.fact: The api-gateway service was pinned to fastapi 0.136.3 because 0.137 broke include_router via a starlette upper-bound.
scenarios.question: What version of fastapi is api-gateway pinned to, and why?
scenarios.reference_answer: fastapi 0.136.3, pinned because 0.137 broke include_router due to a starlette upper-bound issue.

scenarios.reference_answer: A smoke test must pass; the rule was added after a 2026-05-10 incident where an unhealthy build reached prod.
